749e8ce9887f7a1b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل رعاية للمرضى. المسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه، وإجراء دراسة دقيقة للحالة المرضية. تنفيذ الفحص السريري وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية حسب الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمهام ومسؤوليات الدور. موقع العمل يتوفر هذا الدور في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

7455539ae055f196.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرؤيه الخضراء للانجيله الصناعيه عن مشغل آلة معالجة خيوط غزل للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة وصيانة آلات معالجة خيوط الغزل لضمان جودة الإنتاج وسلامة العمليات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمبتدئين أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل آلات معالجة خيوط الغزل وفقاً للمواصفات المطلوبة ومراقبة أدائها بانتظام. التحقق من مطابقة المنتج للمواصفات الفنية والمعايير المحددة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات. تحديد المشكلات الفنية واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لضمان استمرارية الإنتاج. تنظيف المعدات وإجراء أعمال الصيانة الأساسية للحفاظ على كفاءتها. إعداد تقارير مفصلة بالأعطال ورفعها إلى فنيي أو تقنيي الصيانة المختصين. الاحتفاظ بسجل دقيق لجميع الأعمال المنفذة وعمليات الصيانة. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. تخزين المنتجات وتنفيذ إجراءات الاختبار للتأكد من أن الأجهزة تعمل على النحو الأمثل أثناء الإنتاج. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في تشغيل آلات معالجة خيوط الغزل أو مجال صناعي مشابه. القدرة على فهم واتباع المواصفات الفنية وإجراءات التشغيل. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في بيئة العمل. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات جيدة في الملاحظة لتحديد المشكلات المحتملة في الآلات. القدرة على أداء مهام الصيانة الأساسية والتنظيف. مهارات تواصل فعالة لإعداد التقارير والتنسيق مع فريق الصيانة. الالتزام بالدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل لضمان جودة الإنتاج. بيئة العمل يعمل مشغل آلة معالجة خيوط الغزل في بيئة صناعية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الدور يتطلب العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تحقيق أهداف الإنتاج مع الالتزام الصارم بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

746f8ad0a32c9e3c.description: About * Renal Care Saudi Arabia * Renal Care Saudi Arabia is a leader in the dialysis industry, committed to recruiting top talent and fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. The Role of Resident Nephrologist This full-time position for a Resident Nephrologist is based in Makkah, with operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role is responsible for providing quality patient care, clinical leadership, and oversight of clinical teammate care delivery, focusing on the day-to-day management of patients undergoing end-stage renal disease (ESRD) treatment. Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Participate in daily bedside management rounds under the supervision of a Specialist Physician Nephrology or Consultant Nephrologist. Assume an active role in on-call duty rotations within the center. Admit patients referred from other hospital facilities after consultation with the responsible physician. Evaluate new admissions and coordinate investigation plans with attending physicians and nursing staff to establish diagnoses and management courses. Document patient plans in charts and maintain updated follow-up notes. Supervise the clinical team in their duties and responsibilities and actively participate in unit rounds. Execute required diagnostic procedures on patients and guide the clinical team when feasible. Encourage and support staff in acquiring specialized procedure skills under senior supervision. Participate in medical care delivery for in-center or home therapy services, preferably arranging follow-up for discharged patients. 740e3b43bb1162b2.description: We are hiring a Head of Investor Relations to lead the team that runs our investor network. Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put break-out founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and our team runs the investor relations work around every introduction. We are paid by the founder for our work, never by the round. Investors are members of the network and pay nothing. We are a small, senior team, profitable and self-funded. The role This is a leadership seat. You run the IR team: around six direct reports, the associates who each hold a book of members and clients. You report directly to the two co-founders. Your job is to make that team excellent. You hire well, set a clear bar, run the weekly rhythm, coach every associate on their calls and pitches, and have the hard conversation early when someone is off track. The team’s results are your results. Founders work with us for our investor network. Members read what we send because it fits what they told us. Through your team, you own that network and keep every relationship getting stronger month after month. You still take the mandate calls with our most senior family offices, because a leader who stays close to the work coaches it better. What you will own The IR team: around six direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, weekly 1:1s, coaching, performance, and a clear bar for what good looks like. The team’s rhythm: a weekly kickoff, a weekly review of every win and loss, and a team that runs on its own when you are not in the room. The health of the investor network: more active members every month, and every member getting deals that fit their thesis at the pace they asked for. Pitch quality: every introduction your team sends is one you would put your own name on. A weekly read on the numbers to the co-founders: mandate calls, activations, pitches, founder calls and referrals. Senior mandate calls with family offices and strategic investors, including new regions. Close work with our client success team, so every client’s raise keeps moving. You are a fit if you Have run a team before, ideally around six direct reports, and can show what they achieved under you and who you grew. Have hired, coached and, when needed, let go of people, and held a team to a standard without doing their work for them. Have 6 or more years on the investment side of a family office, VC or growth fund, or in capital raising for private companies. Hold real, current relationships with family offices, and know what they ask before they take a founder call. Write a two-line pitch an investor reads to the end. Run on systems: CRM discipline, a clear weekly rhythm, nothing left in your head. Treat discretion as a reflex: founders’ numbers and members’ names stay confidential. Work like it is 2026: AI tooling runs the admin so your hours go to people. What we offer US$200K to US$300K total compensation. Fully remote, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time. A seat reporting directly to both co-founders, a team to lead, and a network that grows with every month you put into it. How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to a short application form. We read every application. Please do not name investors or companies from past roles anywhere in it.

746e5b17404107be.description: About Echelon and the Role Echelon is a Saudi-born sovereign technology company focused on bringing global AI technologies to the Kingdom. The company deploys these technologies with its engineering organization, integrates partner technology into Echelon IP, and productizes Saudi-developed capabilities over time. Echelon operates with a single aggregated P&L at the group level, measures business units by contribution margin, and uses a published framework for pricing open seats. The company is establishing a Delegation of Authority with quarterly expenditure ceilings. Accounting has been managed by an outsourced provider to date. Echelon is seeking a Head of Finance to build and own the finance function end-to-end. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves leading the group through its first institutional funding round and its first audited year as a multi-entity company. The successful candidate will define the financial methodology and grow the finance team in alignment with the group's expansion. Key Responsibilities Manage the monthly close and management reporting for the group and by business unit, ensuring reliability for the Management Committee and the Board. Oversee the budget, quarterly forecast, and five-year financial model as the single source of truth, reconciled with the Board pack and partnership strategy. Manage cash, treasury, statutory accounts, tax, and audit for the Saudi operating company and the holding company, including transitioning accounting in-house to a suitable ledger and ERP system. Own the finance aspects of the Delegation of Authority, covering expenditure approvals against quarterly ceilings and providing the Finance perspective on all seat releases. Manage the data room, provide deal support, and handle the financial aspects of term sheets, including partner revenue-share economics and transfer pricing. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in finance. Qualified with CPA, ACCA, CA, or an equivalent certification. Demonstrated hands-on experience in personally owning a financial close, forecast, and audit, beyond just review. Working knowledge of ZATCA, GOSI, and Saudisation reporting requirements, or deep GCC exposure with a willingness to learn these rapidly. Experience in a venture-backed or fast-scaling company is valued. Proficiency in English is required; Arabic is an advantage. Core Values and Approach Customer First: Measure work by customer outcomes and prioritize accordingly. Ownership Mentality: Take full responsibility for outcomes and proactively address issues. Clear Communicator: Explain complex information simply to diverse audiences and ensure the value of work is visible. Comfortable with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information and enjoy solving problems without existing structures. Work Environment and Reporting The Head of Finance will report directly to the Managing Director. This role is based in Riyadh, with travel across the Kingdom as required. The ability to quickly learn new jurisdictions, systems, or instruments is essential, along with strong judgment in financial decisions and policy adherence. Compensation and Benefits The compensation package includes a base salary, housing, transport, and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Specific terms will be shared at the offer stage.

743c8ace59687d12.description: Shift Engineer (CCGT Power Plant) Project: Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Location: Rumah, Riyadh province, Saudi Arabia Job Purpose To supervise and manage shift operations at a (CCGT) power plant, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Gas Turbines (GT), Steam Turbines (ST), Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSG), and associated Balance of Plant (BOP) systems while achieving generation targets, operational efficiency, and HSSE standards. Minimum Experience Minimum 8 years of experience in power generation plant operations, preferably in CCGT facilities. At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or shift leadership role. Hands-on experience operating Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, HRSG, and associated auxiliary systems. Knowledge of GT/ST start-up, shutdown, synchronization, and load management. Understanding of electrical systems, protection systems, and grid coordination. Knowledge of PTW, LOTO, and emergency response procedures. SAP working knowledge is preferred. Strong leadership, decision-making, and communication skills. Desired Certifications / Training CCGT Plant Operations Training. Gas Turbine and Steam Turbine Operations Training. PTW and LOTO Certification. HSE and Emergency Response Training. Required to work rotational shifts. Must be available to respond to plant emergencies and operational disturbances.
